data.text: I’m committing to 10 tons for April. Luke, I appreciate you offering to sit out, but you’re part of this fishing community now—you should earn a living alongside us. Your plan gives us a bigger payout today only by shrinking next month’s catch. Ten tons each keeps everyone earning $10,000 a month without drawing down the lake our families depend on. Let’s keep the combined catch at 50 tons and check the reported catches together afterward. John, can we count on you for 10?
